messages.subject: Global Sustainability & Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Strelczak,

Your leadership of sustainability search at Madison Hunt across infrastructure, energy, climate and sustainability makes this a highly relevant introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder strategy.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across sustainability, energy transition, ESG, external affairs and responsible business. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments across the GCC, Europe, Africa, Asia-Pacific and the Americas.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
